raw_design_bindings.title: A transition whole denotes processed state change

design.binding: independent quality-state annotations on at least five physical folios and untouched held paths, retaining dry/moist rivals
design.contrast: dry-to-moist and moist-to-dry occurrences versus same-quality controls matched by section and position
design.countermodel: The transition pattern reflects section or page layout, with no semantic state operator; direction should vanish under matched same-quality controls.
design.mechanism: The whole is a state-change operator whose role depends on the ordered quality transition and predicts the next state-bearing field.
design.prediction: A state-change candidate predicts the direction and next state field across held folios; material-name and terminal rivals do not show directional transfer.
design.related: GDT625 ordered quality-state paths; GDT762 moist-medium discrimination; no cthy-specific claim is made
design.scope: cached quality-state paths and admitted exact-whole occurrences; feasibility unknown until quality tags are independently bound outside the discovery paths
design.unit: adjacent complete-whole pair or field crossing an independently tagged quality transition

raw_design_bindings.title: An omitted argument reuses the current carrier value

design.contrast: argument-free successor with inherited carrier versus successor with a visible replacement argument; compare against a null model allowing silent carrier changes
design.falsifier: Any predeclared set of argument-free successors that systematically changes carrier value, or inherits an incompatible/empty value despite a fixed preceding carrier, falsifies the ellipsis rule.
design.mechanism: Argument values persist across an immediately following card only when no replacement argument is visibly written; OT/OL determines opening versus continuation, while the carrier value remains the same.
design.prediction: Argument-free successors preserve the preceding carrier value; visible Y/AIIN/AIN/OR successors replace it. The distinction should hold across the six observed OT/OL/DY envelopes.
design.related: Distinct from prior antecedent/reference and role-position proposals: this tests omission-based value inheritance inside an exact argument slot, not lexical anaphora, line breaks, genre, or portable translation. GDT559 is a primary predecessor whose 157/157 result motivates the question; the proposal retains that result as unconfirmed historical evidence.
design.scope: GDT559 observed state-card stream; independent semantic binding availability_unknown because the carrier labels remain working hypotheses, not externally authored meanings
design.unit: complete OT/OL state cards with a final visible argument and an immediate successor classified as argument-bearing or argument-free

corrections: The first IDEA11 peer calls a paraphrase a design binding and omits related/scope fields. Root instead binds the complete unchanged raw design to its original proposal; the peer text is commentary, not an exact binding.

IDEA11 summary suggests a resulting state but its mechanism specifies a change operator. Direction and next-state prediction do not yet separate these roles from a processed-material noun or closure correlated with the operation. Perfect state annotations alone would not resolve that logical overlap.

Adding warmed water can maintain the same water carrier and can itself implement keeping warm. Carrier identity and thermal outcomes therefore do not select the lexical gloss. A transfer requirement can distinguish a narrower ADD contract only in a complete observation that excludes transfer; KEEP need not prohibit addition.

GDT559 imports upstream inherited_argument_root labels. Root traced their construction: GDT416 preserves owner state and assigns the last explicit argument when an action is active; GDT539 initializes state per statement and applies the same conditional inheritance. Pure DY and actionless contexts have explicit guards. Thus 157/157 is a consistency result for the selected eligible transitions, not independent referent annotation.

Argument root/value class and individual referent are distinct. Equal Y/AIIN/AIN/OR labels do not by themselves establish identity of a physical object. The raw ellipsis proposal must choose its endpoint explicitly.

GDT562/563 reconstruct and expand the same working memory machinery. The 54/54 source-pointer match is independent code reconstruction, not independent manuscript semantics. The 101 context-variable recipes and 33 OL renderings are model output variation, not observed lexical polysemy.

## Ein Rezept ist ein Rahmen, nicht zwingend ein ganzer Satz

Die 1.656 Karten verwenden 402 exakte Rezepte. 301 Rezepte ergeben in allen
beobachteten Kontexten nur eine Mikrophrase, aber 262 davon kommen überhaupt
nur einmal vor. Der aussagekräftigere Vergleich ist daher:

```text
140 wiederkehrende Rezepte
 39 mit einer einzigen Mikrophrase
101 mit mehreren Mikrophrasen, zusammen 1.277 Karten
```

Das variable Extrem ist das bloße `OL=FORTSETZEN`: Es trägt in den vorhandenen
Satzkontexten 33 Mikrophrasen, weil Handlung und Argument aus dem aktiven
Satzspeicher kommen. Das macht `OL` nicht zu 33 Wörtern. Sein stabiler Beitrag
bleibt „weiter/fortsetzen“; die längere Anweisung entsteht kompositionell:

```text
OL + aktives HALTEN + aktiver ANTEIL  → Weiter: halte den Anteil.
OL + aktives GEBEN  + aktiver POSTEN  → Weiter: gib den Posten.
OL + aktives NEHMEN + aktiver POSTEN  → Weiter: nimm den Posten.
```

Genau dieses Verhalten passt besser zu einem kleinen gelernten Codevokabular
mit Satzgedächtnis als zu grotesk langen Ganzwortdefinitionen.
